tagline: A walk-around demo: a two-storey office block with desks, a lounge with a pool table and a car park full of cars.
overview:
The Office Demo is one of RedEngine's example scenes: an office building to wander around rather than a game to win. It stands in a fenced lot with a car park full of parked cars. Inside are open-plan desks and a staff lounge with a pool table, and you can go up to the roof.

You walk around in first person (Q switches to third person) carrying the default baseball bat. There are no goals or scores; it exists to show off the engine's building, vehicle and furniture models.
story: No story: an office block after hours, the desks empty and everyone gone home, the cars still in the car park. It was built as a showcase of RedEngine's buildings, vehicles and office furniture.
goal: There is no goal and no way to win or lose: explore.
rules: Walk anywhere in the office, on the roof and around the car park.
Your bat can knock loose objects around.
Nothing is scored and there is no time limit.
